_comment: Hand names for 04887050 tables (family A), read from the code; also used for 04887051.

0B18.name: FlexEthanolRpm
0B18.desc: Flex fuel: value against ethanol content (rows) and RpmCurveValue (columns), both as positions; read in FuelCorrections like FlexEthanolRpm in 05293190AC

0C11.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor1
0C11.desc: Flex fuel: factor against ethanol content (rows) and coolant, first of the three coolant factors read in FuelCorrections (order as in 05293190AC)

0BB4.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor2
0BB4.desc: Flex fuel: second coolant factor against ethanol content and coolant (FuelCorrections)

0CC2.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor3
0CC2.desc: Flex fuel: third coolant factor against ethanol content and coolant (FuelCorrections)

09B1.name: AfterStartDecay
09B1.desc: After-start enrichment against time since start (rows) and CrankCoolant (columns); part of the warm-up factor in FuelCorrections

0D1F.name: EgrFuelCorrection
0D1F.desc: 17 x 17 fuel correction against MAP (rows, through PartThrottleMapScale) and rpm, applied in FuelCorrections only while the EGR solenoid is on (ControlFlags944 bit 2); in 05293190AC EgrControl reads PartThrottleFuelMain for this; its rpm axis is the same as that of PartThrottleFuelMain in 05293190AC

180B.name: EgrSpark
180B.desc: Spark correction with EGR on, MAP x rpm (EgrSparkCalc), as EgrSpark in 05293190AC

51F3.name: FuelEventOffset
51F3.desc: FuelEventCalc: Lookup2D of FuelEventOffsetIn ($059A); stock column 0..2 added to FuelEventCylFactor * CylinderIndex to index 12-byte per-cylinder table at $51E7.

1CB3.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
1CB3.desc: KnockRetardMaxCalc: MAP-indexed retard limit when coolant >= KnockCoolantMin and rpm >= KnockRetardMaxRpmMin, and either throttle above closed < KnockRetardMaxThrottle or rpm >= KnockRetardMaxRpm2; otherwise zero or KnockRetardMaxLow.

1C8B.name: KnockNoiseLearnWeight
1C8B.desc: A/B: lower bound of learned background knock noise versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockNoiseDA7 and used as the lower clamp in KnockCylinderRetard. Legacy name; not a filter weight.

1C7F.name: KnockWindowRpm
1C7F.desc: A/B: old-sample coefficient for the learned background knock noise filter versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockWindowFactor. Complementary coefficient weights KnockSignal. Legacy name; not a direct sampling-window duration.

3DAD.name: KnockRetardMaxRpm
3DAD.desc: A/B: lower unsigned filtered knock-signal diagnostic threshold versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockSensorCheck. A filtered value below this or at/above KnockSignalMax enters fault qualification. Legacy name; not a retard angle.

1C63.name: KnockSensorCheckRpm
1C63.desc: A/B: MAP threshold versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockMapThreshold. Used by KnockSample, KnockLearn, KnockLearnUpdate and KnockCylinderRetard with consumer-specific equality behavior. Legacy name; not a diagnostic signal threshold.

1C97.name: KnockNoiseMax
1C97.desc: A/B: upper bound of learned background knock noise versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockNoiseDA6 and used as the upper clamp in KnockCylinderRetard.

059A.name: FuelEventOffsetIn
059A.desc: Input event code for FuelEventOffset and other fuel event timing branches. A/B directly read this byte; no alternate input selection established in these reviewed paths.

1CAF.name: KnockRetardMaxRpmMin
1CAF.desc: Below this rpm KnockRetardMaxCalc returns zero; at or above, evaluate the throttle/rpm2 gates after coolant qualification.

1CB0.name: KnockRetardMaxThrottle
1CB0.desc: Throttle above closed below this threshold selects KnockRetardMaxMap after coolant and minimum-rpm gates; at or above, rpm2 selects map versus low limit.

1CB1.name: KnockRetardMaxRpm2
1CB1.desc: With throttle at or above KnockRetardMaxThrottle and other gates satisfied, rpm below this threshold selects KnockRetardMaxLow, otherwise KnockRetardMaxMap.

1CB2.name: KnockRetardMaxLow
1CB2.desc: Fixed retard limit when coolant and minimum-rpm gates pass, throttle is at or above threshold and rpm is below KnockRetardMaxRpm2.

1CD8.name: KnockCoolantMin
1CD8.desc: KnockRetardMaxCalc returns zero below this coolant threshold; equality passes this gate. Other callers not reclassified.
